title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-2729: 4 pre-existing oscore test failures
description: 4 tests in lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs fail with Replay or unexpected Ok errors, pre-existing before commit 9dab78c. Tests: delayed_explicit_piv_ordinary_response_ignores_peer_replay_window, dropped_pending_response_preserves_committed_window_across_large_jump, oversized_explicit_piv_response_does_not_poison_valid_retry (all Replay), public_unprotect_rejects_malformed_inner_options (unwrap_err got Ok). Replay failures appear related to is_replay window boundary (diff >= WINDOW_SIZE vs >). The malformed options test accepts options it should reject. All pre-date this commit.
